WATERFRONT holds as lakefront: ODNR calls them '9 Premium Sites (lake-side)', bookable nightly by RV (29-50 ft). Plotted on imagery: 029 roughly 30 m across open lawn to the shore, beside a dock; 028, 030 about 50 m; 024-026 about 40 m with some trees between (ReserveOhio's points match the visible pads). 053 and 055 sit on the south loop about 75 m from water through trees, so the note's 'sit on the ... shoreline' is generous for those two. Note left alone since it isn't wrong for the rest.

Pin 39.2182,-84.0601 sits at site 028-030, fine for the shoreline loop; 115 m from the electric centroid. No split: one campground. No closure notice. Website could use the campground page https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/stonelick-state-park-campground.
